notes.title: RoShamBo Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello Fighters!

In this update we increased game stability, fixed bugs to make gameplay even smoother then it was. Besides that we have a great news for you - Friends List is back live. Call your friends, compete each other and knock their teeth out!
